column1: # Agent versions with a published security fix. One line each, tab separated. After editing, run: bash tools/gen.sh
#   id        what lines of the same tool share: they make one row in the report
#   name      as the report shows it
#   os        all, mac, linux or win (win is Git Bash and gird-check.ps1)
#   kind      plist   an Info.plist's CFBundleShortVersionString (an XML plist; a binary one is not read)
#             folder  the highest version-named folder in a folder
#             npm     a package's package.json in the global npm installs and npx's cache
#             mcparg  name@version in the MCP configs section 2 reads
#   where     plist and folder: a path, with the path tokens of data/sessions.tsv or an absolute path.
#             npm and mcparg: the package name
#   affected  <fixed, or >=first <fixed. The fixed version is what the report says to update to
#   hole      what the hole allows, a few words from the advisory
#   advisory  the advisory's https link
# Versions compare part by part as numbers. A version that is not numbers and dots is not reported.
# Cursor is read on macOS only: its version file on the other systems was not verified.
# id
